paragraphs: If your SLC200 has the M274 4-cylinder petrol engine - which is the only engine used in the SLC200 across its full 2016-2020 production run - timing chain wear is an established pattern on this engine family, shared with the wider M270/M274 family used across C-Class models of the same era.
We replace the timing chain, bearings and gaskets as standard on every M274 rebuild.
warning.source: Source: established specialist pattern (per G-BRF, confirmed in original model page build). This issue applies to the M274 engine as used in the SLC200
